title: Synthetic developer tooling grant evaluation
purpose: Rank synthetic proposals by technical feasibility and realistic ecosystem impact based only on their published documentation

criteria.name: Feasibility
criteria.rubric: Compare implementation evidence, test coverage, milestone credibility, unresolved blockers and execution scope. Do not infer missing execution evidence.

criteria.name: Ecosystem impact
criteria.rubric: Compare documented downstream utility, reproducible integrations and realistic adoption evidence, not marketing claims.

candidates.name: BridgeKit
candidates.summary: Bounded analytics-adapter prototype with tests and limited deployments

candidates.name: TraceGarden
candidates.summary: Design-stage observability toolkit without a functioning end-to-end build

candidates.name: SchemaRelay
candidates.summary: Schema exchange prototype with migration risk and demonstration integrations
